email_subject: Application - Digital Content, Search & Engagement Specialist
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Content, Search & Engagement Specialist position at Septentrio. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, GEO, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your mission of keeping Septentrio in Pole Position.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, directly improving organic visibility for clients. My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to implement structured data and optimize for AI search engines, aligning with your focus on AI-driven search visibility.

I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to work with personas, audience engagement, and the Brand Hub, as I enjoy translating technical topics into clear, engaging content. My experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush enables me to monitor performance and recommend improvements.

I am a collaborative team player, eager to learn and grow in an international high-tech environment. I am willing to travel as required and am currently improving my Dutch.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Digital Content, Search & Engagement Specialist position at Septentrio. With a unique blend of technical expertise in SEO, GEO, and content creation, I am confident in my ability to enhance your digital presence and engage your target audiences effectively.

Currently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content writing, directly contributing to improved organic visibility for client websites. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring seamless user experiences. My proficiency with analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs allows me to track performance and make data-driven decisions.

My passion for AI-driven search optimization is demonstrated through my project mirook.com, where I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This aligns perfectly with your focus on AI search visibility and GEO.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work with personas and audience engagement strategies. My experience in creating audience-focused content and my curiosity about customer journeys make me eager to contribute to your lead nurturing and segmentation efforts. Additionally, my familiarity with CMS platforms and my ability to quickly learn new tools will support the Brand Hub rollout and content management.

I am a proactive, organized individual who thrives in collaborative environments. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch, and I am willing to travel internationally as needed.

I am eager to bring my skills to Septentrio and help you shoot for the moon and beyond. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
